function.name: review_sap_code
function.description: Perform a code review (bugs, syntax errors, high-severity risks) of an existing SAP object WITHOUT modifying it. Must be preceded by read_sap_object for the same object. Result is a <code_analysis> envelope. Only use when the user explicitly asks for review/audit/inspection.

object_type.description: Type of SAP object to review

focus_areas.description: Aspects to focus on; default all
